function.arguments: {"message":"Hi! You can have invoices sent to a group (shared) email by updating the billing recipients in your workspace. Go to **Settings → Billing → Recipients**, then add the group address (or replace your own). You can add multiple recipients, so you can keep your personal address alongside the shared inbox if you wish. The change takes effect on the next invoice generated; past invoices won’t be resent to the new address."}

arguments.message: Hi! You can have invoices sent to a group (shared) email by updating the billing recipients in your workspace. Go to **Settings → Billing → Recipients**, then add the group address (or replace your own). You can add multiple recipients, so you can keep your personal address alongside the shared inbox if you wish. The change takes effect on the next invoice generated; past invoices won’t be resent to the new address.
